summary: Authenticated v1 Hono product routes. Register shared default route instances in index.ts; createApp can mount injected Node/SaaS adapters before defaults.

key_files.project-content.ts: Exact Project Resource capability issuance and immutable Document body transport. Checks current admission, Loro reference membership and byte integrity; no raw-key authorization.
key_files.project-assets.ts: Project Asset HTTP adapter: owner/D1 checks, single-shot and chunked R2 imports, signed read receipts, preview capability projections, references, trash/restore through the shared Asset lifecycle (ProjectRoom assets-lifecycle) and the empty personal library. Document reads/commits call ProjectRoom internal assets-* ops.
key_files.admin/gateway.ts: #352/#353 gateway control plane at /api/v1/admin/gateway: price book, packages, top-up packs, rollover; mounts gateway-access.ts (me, admin accounts), gateway-catalog.ts (catalog draft/publish, upstream accounts), gateway-tenants.ts (tenants, read-only members, budgets, keys, rate limits, wallet) and gateway-insights.ts (overview, usage, audit, abuse, audited staff view of retained prompts/responses, retention purge). Admin account sessions only (#394, services/admin-identity.ts before any route); every route authorizes through services/gateway-authz.ts platformRoute; guide apps/docs/guide/gateway-admin.md.
key_files.gateway-billing.ts: #352 tenant credit purchases at /api/v1/gateway/tenants/:tenantId: billing.read (summary) and billing.purchase (subscribe, cancel, top-up) via services/gateway-authz.ts; idempotency key required, no payment provider.
key_files.gateway-team.ts: #354 team settings (product routes, team owner): /teams, /invites/lookup|accept, /tenants/:t members, roles, invites, budgets (hard/soft/alert, override with reason), key/member/tenant rate limits, usage, audit, billing offers, and a member's own /me. Authorized by services/gateway-authz.ts; the admin console only views teams.
key_files.projects.ts: Project CRUD and cloud admission API.
key_files.plugin-catalog.ts: GET generator-definitions, plugin-views, plugin-actions with local-api response shapes; loads the catalog service on first request.
key_files.voice-input.ts: Cloudflare wiring for the shared voice-input HTTP factory. Supplies D1 provider-account/model-card catalog, credential envelopes and usage-audit ports; local ASR stays local-only.
key_files.plugin-settings.ts: POST/GET/DELETE third-party plugin endpoints. Validates https/public hosts at save, seals the signing secret with ACTION_SECRET_KEY, and never returns it.
key_files.model-providers.ts: Provider accounts, model cards and Provider OAuth. Hosted OAuth is the web redirect flow: POST start → vendor → GET /provider-oauth/callback → 302 to /settings?section=providers&providerOAuth&status&code (never a token or code). /complete answers 409 for web flows and 501 for scheme/device-code; /import-local is 501 (needs the user's machine).
